TACO: mean distance over 200 keypoints and 64 frames, 128 sampled windows per split, one sample each; ARCTIC: per-hand RMSE on 8 windows from 2 laptop sequences, 3 samples per arm; the metrics differ, so the panels are not comparable in level, and there are no error bars because neither table gives an interval.
